In City Council September 14th, 2026

Notice is hereby given that the regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council will be held on

Monday evening September 14th, 2026 at 7:00PM in the Council Chambers, City Hall, 45

School St., Brockton, MA.

 

  • The regularly scheduled meeting of the Brockton City Council was called to order by the Council President: 7:00PM
  • Eleven Members Present
  • All present stood and recited the Pledge of Allegiance.

 

APPOINTMENTS:

 

  1. Appointment of Amy E. Stack of 30 Sewell Street, Brockton to the Position of Fire Alarm Operator in the Brockton Fire Department.
  • Councillor Griffin moved to suspend the rules to act on the appointment immediately. The motion was seconded and approved by a hand vote.
  • The Fire Chief introduced Amy Stack, a lifelong Brockton resident, highlighting her high evaluation scores and strong multitasking background in education and the hospitality industry.
  • Confirmed via roll call vote, 11-0 in the affirmative (Councilors Asack, Charnel, DaRosa, Farwell, Griffin, Green, Lally, Nicastro, Tavares, Teixeira, Thompson).
  • Councilor Nicastro moved for reconsideration in hopes that it would fail. Seconded. Reconsideration failed.

MINUTES
SPECIAL LICENSE COMMISSION MEETING
6:00 P.M.
Tuesday, August 4, 2026
G.A.R. Room, City Hall, 45 School Street

___________________________________________________________________________________

The License Commission held a Special Meeting on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, in the G.A.R. Room, 45 School Street. Present were, Commissioners Scott D. Uhlman, Robert Simpson, Christine Derome, Susy Barros, Capt. David Farrell, George Depina, Peter Reardon, and Executive Assistant Silvia Carvalho.

A motion was made by Commissioner Simpson to take the agenda items collectively. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Derome and made unanimous by vote of the members present.

4-0

  1. Hearing on a request from Brockton Arts, Inc. for a Special One Day Permit to Sell All Alcoholic Beverages for a Fundraiser to be held at Enso Gallery- 50 Centre Street, on August 7, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

Present was Mr. A. Applicant of 1 Example Street, Randolph, MA.

Mr. Applicant stated the event is political and he is getting the license on his behalf. Mr. Tony Rodrigues has decided to change the request from All Alcoholic Beverages to Beer and Wine.

  1. Hearing on a request from Brockton Arts, Inc., for a Special One Day Permit to Sell Wine and Malt Beverages for a Movie Night to be held on August 14, 2026, at Enso Gallery- 50 Centre Street, from 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

Present was Mr. A. Applicant of 1 Example Street, Randolph, MA.

Mr. Applicant stated a host is hosting an event and they are seeking permission to serve beer and wine.

  1. Hearing on a request from Brockton Arts, Inc., for a Special One Day Permit to Sell Wine and Malt Beverages for a Paint Night Series to be held at 50 Centre Street, from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m., on the following dates;
    August 29, 2026
    September 26, 2026

Present was Mr. A. Applicant of 1 Example Street, Randolph, MA.

Mr. Applicant stated they are requesting a permit so they can serve beer and wine to the guests. Chairman Uhlman opened the meeting to the public and asked if there was anyone in favor or opposition, and if there were any elected officials that would like to be heard. He closed that portion of the hearing and opened it up to the Commissioners. Capt. Farrell had no objections from the police department. Peter had no objections from the fire department, and requested they have a crowd manager. George had no objections from ISD, and requested he obtain food permits.

A motion was made by Commissioner Simpson to approve the permits. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Derome and made unanimous by vote of the members present.

4-0

A motion was made by Commissioner Simpson to take the agenda items collectively. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Derome and made unanimous by vote of the members present.

4-0

  1. Hearing on request from Capeverdean Association for a Special One Day Permit to Sell Wine and Malt Beverages for a Fundraiser for a retirement to be held at the Shaw’s Center- 1 Feinberg Way, on August 8, 2026, from 8:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m.

Present was Mr. B. Resident of 2 Example Street, Brockton, MA.
